name: magpie-cannbot
description: Cannbot provider for Magpie using CANNWork local sign-in or imported JWT and Virtual Key, with upstream-consistent output clamping, enforced-limit learning and failover within its chain

summary.en: Cannbot models with CANNWork local sign-in or imported JWT and Virtual Key, plus output-limit clamping and automatic long-output switching.
summary.zh: 复用 CANNWork 本机登录态或导入 JWT 与 Virtual Key，接入 Cannbot 模型；输出上限对齐上游，长输出请求自动切换。
